# Task 46 fix 1: rain art legibility at player size

Same worktree/branch (/workspace/wt-seam, rain-skins). AGENTS.md rules. Never run next start/dev. Do not push.

Local screenshots at 2x of the built app: `.muse-ref/local-zoom.png` (git-excluded). Rows: engraving light, engraving dark, watercolor light, watercolor dark, ink light, ink dark. Columns: Off, Drizzle, Moderate, Storm. Compare with `.muse-ref/lluvia-v2-all.png`.

Fix only these, in app/icons-rain.tsx and app/styles/ambience.css:
1. Off is almost invisible in dark theme (engraving and watercolor dashed outline is dark on the dark bar; ink is faint). Under `html[data-theme="dark"]`, the Off dashed outline must use the dark-theme line colour for its skin at an opacity that is clearly visible but still reads as "off" (about .55-.6). Light theme Off stays as is.
2. Engraving at ~30px: the hatch patterns are so dense that Drizzle, Moderate and Storm all read as a solid dark (light theme) / solid pale (dark theme) cloud. Make the three levels distinct like the prototype: Drizzle = light, open single hatch with paper showing; Moderate = denser cross-hatch; Storm = darkest (the extra tone overlay) with the bolt. Do this by retuning the `rb-hatch` / `rb-hatch2` pattern spacing and stroke width for the 30px render (user-space units of the 0 0 100 100 viewBox), not by changing geometry. Same check for ink's `rb-i-hatch` / `rb-i-hatch-x` (ink looks fine; only adjust if needed for consistency).
3. Nothing else: no logic, layout, motion or other skin changes.

Run npm test, typecheck, build, check:size, check:secrets. One commit. Do not push.
